run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate slab placements and write VASP input files for a given bulk surface and adsorbate
run_precompute_slabs: run precompute_slabs to generate and save slab surfaces for a bulk material with specified Miller indices
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse command line arguments for bulk database adsorbate database and placement options
run_write_surface: run write_surface to write VASP input files and metadata pickle for a specified slab surface
run_run_placements: run run_placements to process a single adsorbate bulk surface index tuple and generate placement files via multiprocessing
